_doc: Global skill registry + project-type bundles (mission 2026-07-05). Skills auto-attach: every agent gets its CORE skills (agent-skill-map.json) + the bundle matching the detected project type — no manual reconnection per project. Names reference skills available in this environment (global ~/.claude/skills, forge-* playbooks, ECC skills, built-in Claude Code skills); 'kind' says where it lives. If a required skill is missing at runtime → Skill Boss reports it + assigns a safe labeled fallback (never silently skip).

website.kind: method (SEO Boss audit checklist in forge-website)

app-backend.kind: method (Docs Boss final-report format via forge-report)

projectTypeDetection: Boss detects the project type in the Mission Blueprint (website/n8n/app-backend/research-planning/automation-integration/custom). Custom types get the closest bundle + gaps reported by Skill Boss.
honesty: kind='method' entries are documented procedures (not standalone SKILL.md files) — they live inside the named playbook/agent and are executed as such. Never claim a skill file exists when it is a method.
